question_en: Which statements are true? 1) The direction of the current is the direction of motion of positive charges. 2) The resistance of a conductor is directly proportional to the voltage across it. 3) The ampere is a base SI unit. 4) The current density is $j=IS$.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) Tok yo'nalishi — musbat zaryadlar harakati yo'nalishi. 2) O'tkazgich qarshiligi undagi kuchlanishga to'g'ri proporsional. 3) Amper — SI ning asosiy birligi. 4) Tok zichligi $j=IS$.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) Направление тока — направление движения положительных зарядов. 2) Сопротивление проводника прямо пропорционально напряжению на нём. 3) Ампер — основная единица СИ. 4) Плотность тока $j=IS$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. 1 va 3 to'g'ri. Qarshilik kuchlanishga bog'liq emas; tok zichligi j = I/S.
Asos: tok kuchi va Om qonuni ta'riflari.

rules.en: Resistance does not depend on $U$ and $I$

distractors_ru.A: утверждение 2 неверно: сопротивление не зависит от напряжения

distractors_en.A: statement 2 is false: resistance does not depend on voltage
distractors_en.E: statement 4 is false and statement 1 is true

question_en: The current in a circuit is $1.5\ \mathrm{A}$. What charge passes through the cross-section of the conductor in $4$ minutes ($\mathrm{C}$)?
question_uz: Zanjirdagi tok kuchi $1.5\ \mathrm{A}$. $4$ minutda o'tkazgich kesimidan qancha zaryad o'tadi ($\mathrm{C}$)?
question_ru: Сила тока в цепи $1.5\ \mathrm{A}$. Какой заряд пройдёт через сечение проводника за $4$ минуты ($\mathrm{C}$)?

distractors_ru.D: сила тока разделена на число минут

distractors_en.A: minutes were not converted to seconds
distractors_en.B: time was divided by the current
distractors_en.D: the current was divided by the number of minutes
distractors_en.E: the time was taken as 60 s

question_en: The current in a metal conductor is $3.2\ \mathrm{A}$. How many electrons pass through the cross-section in $5\ \mathrm{s}$? $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.
question_uz: Metall o'tkazgichdagi tok kuchi $3.2\ \mathrm{A}$. $5\ \mathrm{s}$ da kesimdan nechta elektron o'tadi? $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.
question_ru: Сила тока в металлическом проводнике $3.2\ \mathrm{A}$. Сколько электронов пройдёт через сечение за $5\ \mathrm{s}$? $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. q = It = 3.2·5 = 16 C; N = q/e = 16/1.6·10⁻¹⁹ = 10²⁰.
Asos: N = q/e.

distractors_ru.C: вместо умножения на время выполнено деление

distractors_en.B: not multiplied by the time: I/e
distractors_en.C: divided by the time instead of multiplying
distractors_en.E: the charge was multiplied by e

question_en: Using the graph in the figure, find the charge that passes through the cross-section of the conductor in the first $5\ \mathrm{s}$ ($\mathrm{C}$).
question_uz: Rasmdagi grafik bo'yicha dastlabki $5\ \mathrm{s}$ da o'tkazgich kesimidan o'tgan zaryadni toping ($\mathrm{C}$).
question_ru: По графику на рисунке найдите заряд, прошедший через сечение проводника за первые $5\ \mathrm{s}$ ($\mathrm{C}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Zaryad — grafik ostidagi trapetsiya yuzi: q = (6 + 2)/2 · 5 = 20 C.
Asos: I(t) grafigi ostidagi yuz.

en: The current falls linearly from $6\ \mathrm{A}$ to $2\ \mathrm{A}$: $$q=\frac{I_1+I_2}{2}t=\frac{6+2}{2}\cdot5=20\ \mathrm{C}$$

rules.en: Charge is the area under the $I(t)$ graph

distractors_en.A: only the initial current was used: 6·5
distractors_en.B: only the final current was used: 2·5
distractors_en.C: the sum was not divided by 2

question_en: A wire of cross-section $4\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ carries a current of $10\ \mathrm{A}$. Find the current density ($\mathrm{A/m^2}$).
question_uz: Ko'ndalang kesimi $4\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ bo'lgan simdan $10\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tmoqda. Tok zichligini toping ($\mathrm{A/m^2}$).
question_ru: По проводу сечением $4\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ идёт ток $10\ \mathrm{A}$. Найдите плотность тока ($\mathrm{A/m^2}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. S = 4·10⁻⁶ m²; j = I/S = 10/4·10⁻⁶ = 2.5·10⁶ A/m².
Asos: tok zichligi j = I/S.

distractors.A: bu A/mm² da, A/m² da emas

distractors_ru.A: это в A/mm², а не в A/m²

distractors_en.A: this is in A/mm², not A/m²
distractors_en.B: the numbers I and S were multiplied

question_en: A wire of cross-section $1\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ carries a current of $4\ \mathrm{A}$. The concentration of free electrons is $5\cdot10^{28}\ \mathrm{m^{-3}}$. Find the drift speed of the electrons ($\mathrm{mm/s}$). $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.
question_uz: Ko'ndalang kesimi $1\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ bo'lgan simdan $4\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tmoqda. Erkin elektronlar konsentratsiyasi $5\cdot10^{28}\ \mathrm{m^{-3}}$. Elektronlarning tartibli harakat tezligini toping ($\mathrm{mm/s}$). $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.
question_ru: По проводу сечением $1\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ идёт ток $4\ \mathrm{A}$. Концентрация свободных электронов $5\cdot10^{28}\ \mathrm{m^{-3}}$. Найдите скорость упорядоченного движения электронов ($\mathrm{mm/s}$). $e=1.6\cdot10^{-19}\ \mathrm{C}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. v = I/(neS) = 4/(5·10²⁸ · 1.6·10⁻¹⁹ · 10⁻⁶) = 5·10⁻⁴ m/s = 0.5 mm/s.
Asos: I = neSv.

distractors.E: faqat neS hisoblangan, I ga bo'linmagan

distractors_en.E: only neS was calculated, no division

question_en: The voltage across a $24\ \Omega$ resistor is $36\ \mathrm{V}$. Find the current through the resistor ($\mathrm{A}$).
question_uz: Qarshiligi $24\ \Omega$ bo'lgan rezistor uchlaridagi kuchlanish $36\ \mathrm{V}$. Rezistordan o'tayotgan tok kuchini toping ($\mathrm{A}$).
question_ru: Напряжение на концах резистора сопротивлением $24\ \Omega$ равно $36\ \mathrm{V}$. Найдите силу тока через резистор ($\mathrm{A}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. I = U/R = 36/24 = 1.5 A.
Asos: Om qonuni.

question_en: A charge of $90\ \mathrm{C}$ passes through a conductor of resistance $20\ \Omega$ in $3$ minutes. Find the voltage across the conductor ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: Qarshiligi $20\ \Omega$ bo'lgan o'tkazgichdan $3$ minutda $90\ \mathrm{C}$ zaryad o'tdi. O'tkazgich uchlaridagi kuchlanishni toping ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: Через проводник сопротивлением $20\ \Omega$ за $3$ минуты прошёл заряд $90\ \mathrm{C}$. Найдите напряжение на концах проводника ($\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. I = q/t = 90/180 = 0.5 A; U = IR = 0.5·20 = 10 V.
Asos: I = q/t va U = IR.

distractors_en.B: minutes were not converted to seconds
distractors_en.C: R was divided by the current
distractors_en.D: the charge was multiplied by the resistance
distractors_en.E: the current was divided by R

question_en: The figure shows the current–voltage characteristics of two conductors. Find the ratio $\frac{R_1}{R_2}$.
question_uz: Rasmda ikki o'tkazgichning volt-amper xarakteristikalari berilgan. $\frac{R_1}{R_2}$ nisbatni toping.
question_ru: На рисунке даны вольт-амперные характеристики двух проводников. Найдите отношение $\frac{R_1}{R_2}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. R₁ = 2/4 = 0.5 Ω, R₂ = 6/3 = 2 Ω; R₁/R₂ = 0.25.
Asos: R = U/I.

ru: По узлам сетки на прямых: $$R_1=\frac{2}{4}=0.5\ \Omega,\qquad R_2=\frac{6}{3}=2\ \Omega$$
en: From grid points on the lines: $$R_1=\frac{2}{4}=0.5\ \Omega,\qquad R_2=\frac{6}{3}=2\ \Omega$$

distractors_en.B: this is only the second resistance
distractors_en.C: this is only the first resistance
distractors_en.E: the ratio of the currents at the points was taken

question_en: Find the resistance of an aluminium wire of length $100\ \mathrm{m}$ and cross-section $1.4\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ ($\Omega$). $\rho=2.8\cdot10^{-8}\ \Omega\cdot\mathrm{m}$.
question_uz: Uzunligi $100\ \mathrm{m}$, ko'ndalang kesimi $1.4\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ bo'lgan aluminiy simning qarshiligini toping ($\Omega$). $\rho=2.8\cdot10^{-8}\ \Omega\cdot\mathrm{m}$.
question_ru: Найдите сопротивление алюминиевого провода длиной $100\ \mathrm{m}$ и сечением $1.4\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ ($\Omega$). $\rho=2.8\cdot10^{-8}\ \Omega\cdot\mathrm{m}$.

question_en: The resistance of a copper wire is $2\ \Omega$. What is the resistance of a copper wire whose length is $3$ times larger and diameter $2$ times smaller ($\Omega$)?
question_uz: Mis simning qarshiligi $2\ \Omega$. Uzunligi $3$ marta katta, diametri $2$ marta kichik bo'lgan mis simning qarshiligi qancha ($\Omega$)?
question_ru: Сопротивление медного провода $2\ \Omega$. Каково сопротивление медного провода, длина которого в $3$ раза больше, а диаметр в $2$ раза меньше ($\Omega$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Diametr 2 marta kichik — kesim 4 marta kichik; R 3·4 = 12 marta ortadi: 2·12 = 24 Ω.
Asos: R ∼ l/d².

en: The area is $4$ times smaller ($S\sim d^2$): $$\frac{R'}{R}=\frac{3l}{S/4}\cdot\frac{S}{l}=12$$

distractors_ru.A: принято, что сечение уменьшилось в 2 раза
distractors_ru.D: принято, что сечение увеличилось в 4 раза
distractors_ru.E: принято, что сечение увеличилось в 2 раза

distractors_en.A: the area was assumed to decrease 2 times
distractors_en.C: only the length was taken into account
distractors_en.D: the area was assumed to increase 4 times
distractors_en.E: the area was assumed to increase 2 times

question_en: A wire of resistance $48\ \Omega$ is cut into $4$ equal pieces which are twisted together side by side along their length. Find the resistance of the resulting conductor ($\Omega$).
question_uz: Qarshiligi $48\ \Omega$ bo'lgan sim $4$ ta teng bo'lakka qirqildi va bo'laklar uzunligi bo'yicha yonma-yon eshildi. Hosil bo'lgan o'tkazgich qarshiligini toping ($\Omega$).
question_ru: Провод сопротивлением $48\ \Omega$ разрезали на $4$ равные части и скрутили их вместе по длине. Найдите сопротивление полученного проводника ($\Omega$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Uzunlik 4 marta kamayadi, kesim 4 marta ortadi: R' = 48/16 = 3 Ω.
Asos: R' = R/k².

distractors_en.A: only the shorter length was taken into account

question_en: A wire is stretched so that its diameter becomes $2$ times smaller (its volume does not change). How many times does its resistance increase?
question_uz: Sim cho'zilib, diametri $2$ marta kichraytirildi (hajmi o'zgarmadi). Uning qarshiligi necha marta ortdi?
question_ru: Провод растянули так, что его диаметр уменьшился в $2$ раза (объём не изменился). Во сколько раз увеличилось его сопротивление?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Kesim 4 marta kamayadi; hajm saqlangani uchun uzunlik 4 marta ortadi: R 16 marta ortadi.
Asos: lS = const.

uz: Kesim $4$ marta kamayadi, uzunlik $4$ marta ortadi: $$S'=\frac{S}{4},\qquad l'=4l$$
ru: Сечение меньше в $4$ раза, длина больше в $4$ раза: $$S'=\frac{S}{4},\qquad l'=4l$$
en: Area $4$ times smaller, length $4$ times larger: $$S'=\frac{S}{4},\qquad l'=4l$$

distractors_ru.C: принято, что длина увеличилась в 2 раза

distractors_en.B: only the change of area was taken into account
distractors_en.C: the length was assumed to increase 2 times
distractors_en.D: only the ratio of diameters was used

question_en: Find the resistance of a $1\ \mathrm{km}$ section of a steel rail, each metre of which has a mass of $31.2\ \mathrm{kg}$ ($\mathrm{m}\Omega$). The density of steel is $7800\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, $\rho=1.2\cdot10^{-7}\ \Omega\cdot\mathrm{m}$.
question_uz: Har bir metrining massasi $31.2\ \mathrm{kg}$ bo'lgan po'lat relsning $1\ \mathrm{km}$ uzunlikdagi qismi qarshiligini toping ($\mathrm{m}\Omega$). Po'lat zichligi $7800\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, $\rho=1.2\cdot10^{-7}\ \Omega\cdot\mathrm{m}$.
question_ru: Найдите сопротивление участка стального рельса длиной $1\ \mathrm{km}$, каждый метр которого имеет массу $31.2\ \mathrm{kg}$ ($\mathrm{m}\Omega$). Плотность стали $7800\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, $\rho=1.2\cdot10^{-7}\ \Omega\cdot\mathrm{m}$.

distractors.C: bu Ω da, mΩ da emas

distractors_ru.C: это в Ω, а не в mΩ

distractors_en.A: the length was taken as 100 m
distractors_en.B: the length was taken as 10 km
distractors_en.C: this is in Ω, not mΩ
distractors_en.E: the length was taken as 2 km

question_en: A voltage of $11\ \mathrm{V}$ is applied across a nichrome wire of length $5\ \mathrm{m}$. Find the current density in the wire ($\mathrm{A/m^2}$). $\rho=1.1\cdot10^{-6}\ \Omega\cdot\mathrm{m}$.
question_uz: Uzunligi $5\ \mathrm{m}$ bo'lgan nixrom sim uchlariga $11\ \mathrm{V}$ kuchlanish berilgan. Simdagi tok zichligini toping ($\mathrm{A/m^2}$). $\rho=1.1\cdot10^{-6}\ \Omega\cdot\mathrm{m}$.
question_ru: К концам нихромового провода длиной $5\ \mathrm{m}$ приложено напряжение $11\ \mathrm{V}$. Найдите плотность тока в проводе ($\mathrm{A/m^2}$). $\rho=1.1\cdot10^{-6}\ \Omega\cdot\mathrm{m}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. j = U/(ρl) = 11/(1.1·10⁻⁶ · 5) = 2·10⁶ A/m².
Asos: E = U/l, j = E/ρ.

distractors_en.C: this is the field strength, in V/m
distractors_en.D: U, ρ and l were multiplied
